page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and external resources. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across several compute and memory metrics, with specific strengths in memory write operations. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1571.09, while the multi-core CPU performance reaches 33012.14. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached rate of 1856.97 GB/sec and a read-only large block uncached rate of 165.51 GB/sec. Notably, the large block uncached memory write bandwidth is measured at 93.48 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% tier. Single-threaded gzip compression achieves 26.77 GB/sec, and bzip3 decompression scales from 9.79 GB/sec on a single thread to 125.32 GB/sec in multi-threaded execution.

The instance provides dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring consistent compute performance without hyper-threading resource contention. However, the complete absence of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, requiring external block storage for any persistent data. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density of 8 GB per core combined with a 3.3 GHz clock speed makes this instance type suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk I/O. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
